I wrote `component.html` in the folder. It's the 1280px sign-in screen inside `#component`, as static HTML and CSS with no JavaScript. I haven't opened it in a browser, so the layout and fonts are unchecked.

I read `DESIGN.md`, `prompt.txt` and the two session files first. `session.json` is empty. `session.err` only logs an unrecognized-model message.

- **Layout:** A white card with a thin accent-line border sits on the pale blue Sand background. It spans six of the 12 columns, which are set with 64px margins and 32px gutters. The page uses only the listed colors, sizes, spacing and radii.
- **Heading:** "Sign in to Harbor" is Unbounded Light, all caps, 28px. I picked the card-heading size because the 56px page-title size would be too wide for the card.
- **Fields:** "Work email" and "Password" use the 12px all-caps accent labels. The inputs are 48px tall with 12px radius and 16px text.
- **Checkbox and link:** "Keep me signed in" and "Forgot Password?" share one row. Both are at least 44px tall.
- **Buttons:** "Sign In" is the ink-filled pill. "Continue with SSO" is the quiet pill with no fill and a thin ink outline, which I added so it still reads as a button.
- **Motion:** Hover and focus states use the specified easing curve. Transitions are turned off when reduced motion is set.
- **Fonts:** Unbounded and Archivo can't be loaded without outside files. Machines that don't have them installed will show the Helvetica/Arial fallbacks.
